name: PR detail Overview tab renders the Blast Radius card, degraded (no repo-intel index in the seed)
description: From PR #482, land on the Overview tab (the default — no tab click needed) and confirm the Blast Radius card renders: its title (SectionLabel uppercases it via CSS text-transform, so the assertion matches the rendered 'BLAST RADIUS', not the source 'Blast Radius' — see client/docs/insights.md) and the degraded notice's reason text. The seed repo has no repo-intel index at all (server/docs/insights.md), so `GET /pulls/482/blast` comes back `degraded: true, reason: 'no_data'` and the card shows reason.no_data instead of a tree/graph — read-only seeded data, no model call. Prior PRs is deliberately left closed: opening it would fire a live GitHub call. Entry steps copied from specs/08-smart-diff.flow.json; the PR-row click keeps --exact for the same reason as that flow (Next.js inlines the full next-intl messages blob into a <script> tag that a non-exact `find text` can resolve to instead of the real row).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
scroll the Blast Radius card into view (it scrolls inside main, not window)
the Blast Radius card renders (SectionLabel's uppercase title)
degraded reason.no_data renders (the seed has no repo-intel index)
